reason: A plugin evaluation center that recommends plugins, ranks their health, performs read-only heuristic scans of specified local directories, and produces combined installation guidance.

summaries.zh: 用于根据需求推荐插件、查看健康评分、对指定本地目录进行静态扫描，并综合生成安装建议。
summaries.en: Evaluates plugins by matching needs, showing health scores, scanning specified local directories heuristically, and producing combined installation guidance.

capabilities: Recommends plugins based on stated needs
Provides plugin health rankings from catalog data
Reads and statically scans a user-specified local plugin directory
Combines scoring, audit results, and need matching into an installation recommendation
